answer: Require each agent to hold a bonded stake of saffron-valued reputation tokens, priced so one identity costs more than its sybil dividend. At dawn of every epoch, agents must renew a mutual bond: two peers each lock a fraction of stake in a shared escrow that mirrors the other agent's commitment. If either peer behaves maliciously or vanishes, both bonds slash. Honest pairs recycle cheaply; a sybil farmer would need mirrored stake for every fake pair, making clones exponentially expensive. The ledger keeps dawn timestamps so anyone can audit whether a bond still stands.
